A second 2026 State of the Game Industry survey? It can happen! ft. Beth Elderkin & Imran Khan
On this week's BONUS episode of the GameDeveloper.com Podcast, we're diving into a second GDC Festival of Gaming State of the Industry report with all-new data on the world of game development
Game Developer Podcast
November 12, 2026
It's time again for the annual
GDC Festival of Gaming State of the Industry report
. Except, unusually, it's the
second
time this year for the release of this report.
Why two "annual" reports in one year? It's because going forward, GDC Festival of Gaming organizers plan to release the report toward the end of the year instead of at the beginning. That meant either waiting 18 months for another report, or doubling up for two in one year.
Regardless, report means another round of excellent data to inform the game development community. Today we're diving into the results with GDC content marketing manager Beth Elderkin and
GameDeveloper.com
contributing editor Imran Khan to discuss topics like layoffs, excess overtime, and the use of generative AI.
About the Game Developer Podcast
The Game Developer podcast is a bi-weekly podcast chronicling the triumphs, catastrophes, and everything in-between of game development, sharing lessons and strategies fellow developers can use to hone their craft. The Game Developer Podcast is hosted by Bryant Francis, edited by Pierre Landriau, and features music by
Mike Meehan
.
